Density measurement test on RC2 soil; apparatus: Burmister funnel and vibratory compaction; loading: min and max density test. Recorded: gamma_min and gamma_max.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The measurements of this test have not been digitized yet; the setup and the source pages are indexed. The setup below rests on two agent readings of the report that were reconciled; no person has checked it yet. The test setup is incomplete: relative density Dr, fill depth, rate are not reported.
:::
